theme: Light Primary with Dark Mode Support
archetype: Archetype 4 (Swiss & High-Contrast) - Modified for Pristine Health-Tech

core_principles: AI-Native and Anticipatory: Do not feel like a static CRUD app. Design should imply intelligence and proactiveness.
Investor-Ready Polish: Epic/Cerner level architectural depth, but Stripe-level surface polish and typography.
Asymmetric & Organic Tension: Avoid center-aligned 'Bootstrap' looks. Use 'Bento' grid layouts with varying spans for dashboards.
Optical Clarity: Do not use muddy shadows or generic mint-green. Rely on high contrast (deep slate vs bone white) and sharp bright accents for AI interactions.
anti_patterns: NO Inter, Roboto, or generic sans-serif fonts for headings.
NO generic card grids with soft drop shadows.
NO mint-green or generic medical blue as primary colors.

headings.name: Outfit
headings.usage: H1, H2, H3, large marketing numbers. Use tracking-tighter for H1/H2.

body.name: IBM Plex Sans
body.usage: Dashboard data, paragraphs, form labels, small text.

mono.name: IBM Plex Mono
mono.usage: AI confidence scores, lab record numbers, audit logs, dosage metadata.

layout_and_spacing.spacing_scale: Use generous padding: p-6, p-8, p-12. Avoid cramped p-2/p-4 on main containers.
layout_and_spacing.marketing_layout: Asymmetric grids. Use 'Tetris' grid mode (e.g., col-span-8 and col-span-4). Avoid 50/50 generic splits.
layout_and_spacing.dashboard_layout: Bento 'Control Room' grids (gap-4 or gap-6). Use col-span-2 row-span-2 for primary data charts. Make full use of screen real estate without feeling cluttered.
layout_and_spacing.alignment: Always left-align typography unless specifically a hero callout. Optical alignment for icons and text.

surfaces_and_components.buttons: Sharp corners (rounded-none or rounded-sm). Flat colors. On hover, translate-y-[-2px] with a subtle sharp shadow.
surfaces_and_components.navigation: Crystal Glassmorphism. backdrop-blur-xl, bg-white/70 (light) or bg-black/60 (dark), 1px subtle bottom border (border-white/20). Must be z-50.
surfaces_and_components.cards_dashboards: Neo-Brutalist utility. 1px solid border (border-border), flat backgrounds. No muddy drop shadows. On hover, subtle lift.
surfaces_and_components.ai_ocr_preview: Use the 'Tracing Beam' effect. A dynamic 1px glowing border or highly saturated border (accent_ai color) to indicate active AI processing.
surfaces_and_components.tables: Cardless design. Dense, data-rich rows with 1px bottom border on rows. Use font-plex-mono for IDs, dates, and numbers.

motion_and_interactions.scroll: Use Lenis for smooth momentum scrolling on the landing page.
motion_and_interactions.hover_states: Interactive elements must visibly shift (color, subtle transform, or border glow). Focus states must have high contrast rings (ring-2 ring-primary).
motion_and_interactions.ai_loading: Use ASCII art or smooth skeleton loaders with a sweeping accent_ai gradient instead of generic spinners.

images.description: Abstract, high-end 3D rendering of a futuristic medical identity card floating with glowing data points. Use in landing page hero.
Abstract glassmorphism health data visualization floating. Use in the OCR Prescription Upload section.
Doctor typing on computer in office. Use for trust signals or provider portal preview.
Clean, modern hospital corridor. Use for about section or investor-grade architectural background.

instructions_to_main_agent: Install and configure 'Outfit', 'IBM Plex Sans', and 'IBM Plex Mono' fonts from Google Fonts.
Do not use Shadcn 'Card' wrapper for everything. Use raw divs with 1px borders and distinct padding for custom bento grids.
Ensure all buttons, form inputs, and interactive elements have appropriate 'data-testid' attributes (e.g., data-testid='upload-prescription-button').
Use Phosphor Icons or Lucide React. Phosphor is preferred for dense data tables.
Use framer-motion for page transitions and micro-interactions on dashboard widgets.
For the OCR extraction preview, ensure the UI explicitly shows 'Confidence Scores' in the IBM Plex Mono font to sell the AI-native aspect.
